decisions.statement: An entry with no name is dropped.
The name is the key an operation is merged by.
A state this build does not know reads as no state rather than as a guess.
A missing file outranks a parse failure.
A parse failure outranks a failed upload.
A failed upload outranks a sync.
A run that attempted nothing confirms nothing.
A summary has the very operations that decided the verdict.

definition: one verdict over the operations the watcher reported from its last run
